evidence.Medial Meniscus: Minor intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the medial meniscus. No discrete tears.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Degenerative tearing of the lateral meniscus on a background of mucoid degeneration, with partial extrusion of the body.
evidence.Medial OA: High-grade chondral thinning noted in the posterior weightbearing portion of the medial femoral condyle with minor underlying bone stress changes.
evidence.Lateral OA: Full-thickness chondral loss noted along the weightbearing portion of the lateral tibial condyle
evidence.PF OA: Low-grade chondral thinning in the lateral tibiofemoral compartment, and the retropatellar facets. Lateral tibiofemoral and patellofemoral marginal osteophyte formation.
evidence.Effusion: Large knee joint effusion with a degree of synovitis.
evidence.Synovitis: Large knee joint effusion with a degree of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: Large popliteal cyst measuring 3.3 cm x 2 cm x 5.6 cm.
